prompt: Redraw image 1, keeping its dramatic low angle and the figure towering over tiny village rooftops under a dark moon. Over the robe it wears blackened metal plate armor: a dark iron breastplate and heavy black pauldrons, and from each pauldron rises a single curved horn pointing straight upward. The robe is now dark, the color of shadow, deep sepia-black ink wash, tattered at the hem. Inside the hood the face is a smudged, half-erased blur of ink, as if rubbed out of the drawing, with a faint violet haze; no eyes, no mouth. The cracked pale medallion hangs over the breastplate. Three small dark spheres orbit its open hand. It holds a long scythe exactly like the one in image 2: an ornate dark iron head with small decorative flanges and a long, elegant, sweeping crescent blade of solid violet.  Ink and sepia wash with fine cross-hatching on plain aged parchment, continuous to every edge, no border, no torn edges, no text.
